model_annotations.Bulgarian: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean values of hidden states across different layers in a neural network architecture. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," spans from 0 to 22 with tick marks approximately every 5 units, representing the layer index. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," ranges from 0 to 4, indicating the absolute mean value of the hidden states. The plot displays three distinct lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate" with an average value of 0.71, which remains relatively low and stable around 0.2–0.4 until layer 20, then sharply increases to approximately 4.2 at layer 22; an orange dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate" with an average of 0.05, which stays consistently near 0.05 across all layers; and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline" with an average of 0.04, which remains nearly flat at approximately 0.04 throughout the entire range of layers.
model_annotations.Chinese: This line plot, titled "Hidden State Mean," illustrates the absolute mean values of hidden states across different layers in a neural network, comparing three distinct metrics. The x-axis, labeled "Layer," uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 22, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5 units. The y-axis, labeled "Abs Mean," also uses a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 4. The plot displays three lines: a blue dashed line representing the "hidden state mean before gate," which starts at approximately 0.05, remains relatively low and fluctuating between 0.1 and 0.4 until layer 20, then sharply increases to approximately 4.3 at layer 22; an orange dotted line for the "hidden state mean after gate," which remains consistently low, averaging 0.05, and stays near 0.02 to 0.03 across all layers; and a green solid line for the "hidden state mean of baseline," which is nearly flat, averaging 0.04, and remains close to 0.01 to 0.02 throughout the entire range of layers.
